reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NULL OR units IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur / units < 50 THEN 'entry'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur / units < 200 THEN 'mid'
            ELSE 'premium'
       END AS price_band,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category, price_band
